claims.claim: Apple's fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was $109.4 billion.
The quarter's revenue was a June-quarter record.
Revenue was up 16 percent year over year.
Diluted EPS was $2.02.
Diluted EPS was up 29 percent year over year.
Gross margin was lifted by tariff refunds.
EPS was lifted by tariff refunds.
Fiscal Q3 2026 ended June 27, 2026.
Net sales for fiscal Q3 2026 were $109,417 million.
Net sales in the year-ago quarter were $94,036 million.
The release calls the quarter's net sales a June-quarter record.
Reported gross margin was 50.1 percent.
Gross margin includes a favorable impact of approximately 2 percentage points from tariff refunds.
The release presents no non-GAAP or adjusted figures.
Diluted EPS in the year-ago quarter was $1.57.
Diluted EPS includes a $0.11 favorable impact from tariff refunds.
Net income was $29,789 million.
Net income in the year-ago quarter was $23,434 million.
Operating income was $35,695 million.
Operating income in the year-ago quarter was $28,202 million.
R&D expense was $11,729 million.
R&D expense in the year-ago quarter was $8,866 million.
iPhone, Mac and Services each set June-quarter records.
The CEO said iPhone, Mac and Services each grew by double digits.
iPhone net sales were $54,252 million.
iPhone net sales in the year-ago quarter were $44,582 million.
Mac net sales were $10,352 million.
Mac net sales in the year-ago quarter were $8,046 million.
Services net sales were $30,739 million.
Services net sales in the year-ago quarter were $27,423 million.
iPad was the only category below the year-ago quarter.
iPad net sales were $6,191 million.
iPad net sales in the year-ago quarter were $6,581 million.
The CEO cited double-digit growth in every geographic segment.
Greater China net sales were $18,816 million.
Greater China net sales in the year-ago quarter were $15,369 million.
Europe net sales were $29,395 million.
Europe net sales in the year-ago quarter were $24,014 million.
Management cited an all-time-high installed base of active devices.
Management cited the WWDC26 introduction of the all-new Siri AI.
The release gives no figures for the installed base or the Siri AI introduction.
The release provides no guidance or outlook for revenue, margins or earnings for any future period.
Cash generated by operating activities for the nine months ended June 27, 2026 was $116,996 million.
Cash generated by operating activities for the prior-year nine months was $81,754 million.
Share repurchases for the nine months ended June 27, 2026 were $62,094 million.
Share repurchases for the prior-year nine months were $70,579 million.
Dividends and dividend equivalents for the nine months ended June 27, 2026 were $11,778 million.
Dividends and dividend equivalents for the prior-year nine months were $11,559 million.
Cash and cash equivalents were $39,544 million at June 27, 2026.
Commercial paper was $1,997 million at June 27, 2026.
Commercial paper was $7,979 million at September 27, 2025.
Non-current term debt was $71,340 million at June 27, 2026.
Non-current term debt was $78,328 million at September 27, 2025.
The board declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share.
The dividend is payable August 13, 2026.
The dividend record date is August 10, 2026.
The release gives the tariff refunds' effect on gross margin and EPS but not their dollar amount, their timing, or whether more are expected.
Inventories and net intangible assets changed sharply, and the release explains neither change.
Inventories were $11,092 million at June 27, 2026.
Inventories were $5,718 million at September 27, 2025.
Net intangible assets were $20,342 million at June 27, 2026.
Net intangible assets were $11,093 million at September 27, 2025.
The CFO cites a June-quarter record for operating cash flow.
The release shows cash flows only for the nine-month period.
